math_reading_decisions: All page and line references were read individually: p.25 li.10 du bas; p.26 li.10; (7.17.4.1); p.27 li.1 et 2 du bas; p.28; handwritten 7.2. The curved reference numerals in the typed entries have repeated typewriter impressions and remain typed; no whole field was reclassified merely because its digits curve.
The inserted S is an ordinary single-outline typed capital, and its terminal s is an ordinary typed lowercase s. There is no independent double strike or subscript in either.
Both handwritten footnote labels have a raised 1 inside full-height curved parentheses. The body 7.2 is handwritten with a low point between the two digits.

C-context au-dessus/au dessus was checked stroke by stroke and confirmed; the first has an actual hyphen, the second an interword space. The duplicated C-context x/se entries are both covered by decision A72-03.
The text, graphic connector and handwritten call in the p.26 entry were classified component by component: typed parenthesis and S/s; pen connector and footnote call.
